synthetic_data_notice: All students, skills, roles, and availability in this pack are synthetic educational data, not real student records.

objective_terms.name: skill_imbalance
objective_terms.description: Spread of average per-team skill (programming/mathematics/presentation) across teams. Lower is more balanced.

objective_terms.name: schedule_conflict
objective_terms.description: How little a team's members' availability_vector bits overlap. Lower means teammates share more common meeting slots.

objective_terms.name: role_imbalance
objective_terms.description: How unevenly preferred_role is distributed within a team (e.g. a team with four Leaders and no Coder scores worse).

objective_terms.name: team_size_penalty
objective_terms.description: Penalty for a team outside [team_size_min, team_size_max].

objective_formula: J = w1 * skill_imbalance + w2 * schedule_conflict + w3 * role_imbalance + w4 * team_size_penalty
note: This file does not fix w1..w4. Students choose and justify their own weights -- see README.md and the required experiment.
